_about: Settings for the fact sheets (engine/profiles/: build.py, walk_grid.py, fetch_walk.py, fetch_drive.py, page.html): one per community area. 'The subway' here is the CTA 'L' (cta_stations, cta_lines); stops and changes to the hubs are counted along each drawn line, with a change wherever two stations sit within 200 m (Jackson's Red and Blue platforms, Lake and State/Lake). The headline transit time is the map's own To the Loop (ca_profiles.json 'loop'). Metra is the regional rail. No parking rows: Chicago's map has no City parking or EV file yet. factsheet.css colours the line bullets in the CTA's colours and bus badges in its route styles.

page.description: Printable one-page fact sheets for each of Chicago’s 77 community areas: the ’L’, buses, Metra, expressways, drive times, parks, libraries and bike lanes. Drop a pin for walk and drive times from any spot.
